escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep using a certificate bound to an older material head after later code, test, or configuration writes and infer readiness only from a green workflow.

literal_case.procedure: Resolve the fresh PR identity, compare it with the material SHA recorded by the prior handoff, classify recovery with the independent auditor refreeze floor, and require exact-head terminal CI before package regeneration.
literal_case.expected: Material drift is classified as post-write-refreeze and a new handoff is built from the current frozen material candidate.
literal_case.observed: The recovery classifier returned post-write-refreeze and the exact material candidate completed both monorepo and API/PostgreSQL workflow jobs successfully.

prevention_change.evidence: The governing terminal handoff contract forbids publishing a stale certificate after a material write and requires a new freeze before result-only publication.

detection_change.evidence: The recovery classifier was executed against the literal stale candidate and two synthetic transfer surfaces; all material-drift cases resolved to post-write-refreeze.
